_doc: AudioDirector sound bank. sounds.<key>.files are res:// WAVs; one is picked at random per play. volume_db is added to the caller's volume, vol_jitter_db is +- random dB, pitch is a [min,max] range multiplied with the caller's pitch jitter. bus: Master/Music/SFX/VO/Jingles/Ambience. max_voices: simultaneous plays of this key (the oldest is stolen). attenuation: profile in 'attenuation' used by play_3d. loop: the stream loops. Generated by tools_src/gen_audio.py (re-running only refreshes 'files' of existing keys, hand tuning is kept).

casing_tink._doc: T-095: a spent case landing (synthesized, project-owned; CasingPool plays it on the first bounce)

emerge_burst_earth._doc: T-085 rise: earth/stone breaking (stone footsteps slowed; a real earth-burst sample would replace it).

emerge_burst_snow._doc: T-085 rise: the crust breaking (snow footsteps slowed; a real snow-burst sample would replace it).
